summary: Front matter and book-object apparatus leaked into chapter prose.
details: Removed or rewrote preface-like framing, author posture, reader permission/covenant language, descriptions of the book as an object, and closing wrapper material while preserving doctrinal teaching, practice guidance, Quranic interpretation, and supporting citations.
recommendation: Run a separate noise-auditor pass on regenerated downstream surfaces before publication if those artifacts predate this chapter cleanup.

summary: Opening hooks and landing summaries were being counted as teaching concepts, making balanced chapters appear over-dense.
details: Reclassified short setup and synthesis sections as structural frames in chapters 1, 3, 5, 6, 7, 8, and 9. No teaching concept was moved across chapters because whole-section relocation would break approved doctrinal arcs and produce weaker neighboring chapters.
recommendation: For future reconstruction, balance by approved concept density first: three teaching concepts per chapter, with opening and landing sections treated as frames unless they introduce new doctrine.
